about: The avatar of the first-person views (alto/build/fpv_avatar.py) is a respectful, stylised low-poly figure after the CURRENT mayor of the palace's city. `mayor` is written by alto/buildings/mayors.py from Wikidata (head of government, P6) with its source and the date it was read; never type it by hand. `look` holds public-facing cues only (overall build, typical attire, hair, skin tone) for the person named in look.for; it is not a likeness and has no face. When look.for is not the current mayor, or a city has no entry, the neutral generic figure is used.

look.cues: tailored business suit (jacket and knee-length skirt), short dark hair, medium-deep brown skin, medium build
dark suit with white shirt and dark tie, short black hair, short trimmed beard, light-medium brown skin, slim build
